attributes.title: [OpenRouter] Overview
attributes.description: Cross-provider visibility into OpenRouter API usage, cost, and token consumption. Covers request volume, spend by model and provider, token breakdown, and cache efficiency. Data sourced from metrics-openrouter.usage-*.

params.markdown:
## OpenRouter — Usage & Cost Overview
Daily request volume, token consumption, and cost broken down by model and provider.
Data is collected once per day per model/provider combination. Use the time picker to adjust the window.

query.esql:
FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.request_count IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Total Requests` = SUM(openrouter.usage.request_count)

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.request_count IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Total Requests` = SUM(openrouter.usage.request_count)

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.total_usage IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Total Cost (USD)` = ROUND(SUM(openrouter.usage.total_usage), 4)

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.total_usage IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Total Cost (USD)` = ROUND(SUM(openrouter.usage.total_usage), 4)

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.tokens_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Total Tokens` = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_total)

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.tokens_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Total Tokens` = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_total)

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.tokens_total IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.usage.cached_tokens IS NOT NULL
| STATS total_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_total), cached_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.cached_tokens)
| EVAL `Cache Hit %` = ROUND(100.0 * cached_tokens / total_tokens, 1)
| KEEP `Cache Hit %`

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.tokens_total IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.usage.cached_tokens IS NOT NULL
| STATS total_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_total), cached_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.cached_tokens)
| EVAL `Cache Hit %` = ROUND(100.0 * cached_tokens / total_tokens, 1)
| KEEP `Cache Hit %`

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.request_count IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.usage.model IS NOT NULL
| STATS requests = SUM(openrouter.usage.request_count)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), model = openrouter.usage.model
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.request_count IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.usage.model IS NOT NULL
| STATS requests = SUM(openrouter.usage.request_count)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), model = openrouter.usage.model
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.total_usage IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.usage.model IS NOT NULL
| STATS cost_usd = ROUND(SUM(openrouter.usage.total_usage), 4)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), model = openrouter.usage.model
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.total_usage IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.usage.model IS NOT NULL
| STATS cost_usd = ROUND(SUM(openrouter.usage.total_usage), 4)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), model = openrouter.usage.model
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.total_usage IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.usage.provider IS NOT NULL
| STATS cost_usd = ROUND(SUM(openrouter.usage.total_usage), 4) BY provider = openrouter.usage.provider
| SORT cost_usd DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.total_usage IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.usage.provider IS NOT NULL
| STATS cost_usd = ROUND(SUM(openrouter.usage.total_usage), 4) BY provider = openrouter.usage.provider
| SORT cost_usd DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.tokens_prompt IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.usage.tokens_completion IS NOT NULL
| STATS prompt_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_prompt),
        completion_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_completion)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.tokens_prompt IS NOT NULL AND openrouter.usage.tokens_completion IS NOT NULL
| STATS prompt_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_prompt),
        completion_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_completion)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.cached_tokens IS NOT NULL
| STATS cached_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.cached_tokens),
        total_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_total)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.cached_tokens IS NOT NULL
| STATS cached_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.cached_tokens),
        total_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_total)
  BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.model IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    requests = SUM(openrouter.usage.request_count),
    prompt_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_prompt),
    completion_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_completion),
    cost_usd = ROUND(SUM(openrouter.usage.total_usage), 4)
  BY model = openrouter.usage.model, provider = openrouter.usage.provider
| SORT cost_usd DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM metrics-openrouter.usage-*
| WHERE openrouter.usage.model IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    requests = SUM(openrouter.usage.request_count),
    prompt_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_prompt),
    completion_tokens = SUM(openrouter.usage.tokens_completion),
    cost_usd = ROUND(SUM(openrouter.usage.total_usage), 4)
  BY model = openrouter.usage.model, provider = openrouter.usage.provider
| SORT cost_usd DESC
| LIMIT 20
